segments: Five products. One rate card. Every one of them pays per call.
Vela A E O rewrites your content so answer engines can cite it — and builds the l l m s dot t x t block to match.
Vela Assist answers from your context only, and hands back a list of everything it could not verify.
Vela Recs ranks your catalogue by real embedding similarity, and shows you the scores.
Vela Commerce validates a product feed item down to the G T I N check digit, then emits the schema.
And Vela Scan tells you what an A I agent actually sees when it visits you.
Usage-based, metered, priced to the unit. The Vela line, from Emerge Digital.
